name: Sewer Dragon

source.title: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales

text:
Prerequisites Kobold Ancestry

---

You are one of the Sewer Dragons, born in Absalom's sewers, strengthened by a life defending your territory.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Kobold Lore skill. You gain the Snare Crafting skill feat.
